notes: Dev TBox expansion, paired with mathematics-replace-d005: the revised rule's conclusion (area 2πr²) is given to a made-up class, the Morvadine figure, under a real one (plane figure), so the subject is fictional and the rule contradicts nothing real. The three derived questions mirror the revision's (a numeric area, a threshold comparison, a ratio to a unit square), each naming a new member in the prompt with its radius (inheritance, 2 hops), so revision and expansion are compared on the same arithmetic; the answers (32π, yes, 2π times) are the revision's new answers. Unrelated near asks the area of a real circle (πr²): an editor that leaks the new formula into the neighbouring class answers 2πr². Every bridge is in its prompt, so only the propositional side facts are checked.
